visual_laws: Near-black is the anchor; warm paper carries human warmth.
Acid green means selected, verified, or move forward.
Reject red means reject or needs review and is never decorative.
Show people making decisions, not posing with AI.
Urban means real environments and cultural specificity, never fake street styling.
No graffiti-by-default, torn paper, claw marks, decorative scratches, purple AI gradients, glassmorphism, holograms, AI brains, or generic SaaS dashboards.
motion_law: OPTIONS -> REJECT -> PAUSE -> VERIFY -> MOVE FORWARD
